title: Spatially legible contact choreography
objective: Show the intended destination and wrong-surface attachment in a continuous, unobstructed contact view.

interventions.rationale: A separated contact plane may make the existing intention and wrong attachment distinguishable; actual clarity is unverified.

spatialRelationships.instruction: Position {beat_01.expectedSurface} behind {beat_01.actualSurface}, offset to the right so the destination remains visible beside the fingertip.

choreography.instruction: Carry the existing reach diagonally across the lower foreground toward the visible cabinet surface, with the sticky edge facing the viewer.
choreography.consequencePresentation: Keep the cabinet destination visibly clear as the note clings to the finger; leave a narrow visible gap between that finger and the cabinet.

interventions.rationale: A separated contact plane may make the existing intention and wrong attachment distinguishable; actual clarity is unverified.

choreography.instruction: Keep the established pulling motion continuous while the growing notes occupy a widening area across the body silhouette.
choreography.consequencePresentation: Show the existing progressive coverage of arms, legs and face after each count transition without losing the edges of the growing note groups.

stateProgression.placementInstruction: Present {beat_03.state.0} notes as a separated horizontal pair beside the arms.
stateProgression.transitionPresentation: Keep both outer note edges visible during the established pull that leads into the next source count.

stateProgression.placementInstruction: Present {beat_03.state.1} notes as two vertical pairs, offset left and right across the body silhouette.
stateProgression.transitionPresentation: Carry the existing pull continuously across the change, retaining the separated pairs before their next multiplication.

stateProgression.placementInstruction: Present {beat_03.state.2} notes in two horizontal rows of four with gaps, following the existing coverage of arms, legs and face.
stateProgression.transitionPresentation: Let the established body coverage follow the final source count while retaining the group boundaries in the same view.
